answer.text:
Intel Foundry external revenue **declined about 60%** in 2024 versus 2023.

Calculation: \((\$953\text{ million} - \$385\text{ million}) / \$953\text{ million} \times 100 \approx 59.6\%\), rounded to 60%. The filing attributes the decline primarily to **lower traditional packaging services revenue and lower equipment sales**.

Source: Intel 2024 Form 10-K, accession **0000050863-25-000009**, “Intel Foundry Financial Performance” and “Consolidated Revenue,” Filing Summary, chunk IDs **00cec489-cca7-51ce-a50a-2814f0bd9f87** and **e165c6f6-d3cc-50f7-ba46-2514cc990b6e**.
